The goal of software engineering is to produce software that is efficient, easy to use, and maintain so as to fulfil the current and futuristic requirement of the user.  Through this course, student can develop abilities to build a framework to construct good quality software products and ensuring their reliability. Also, students can combine their domain-specific expertise with programming abilities to create superior software products . subjects.name: Data Communication and Computer Network
subjects.overviewEn: This course covers foundational and advanced principles of computer networking and data communications, progressing through the physical transmission media, Data Link layer framing and error control, Network layer IP routing and subnetting, Transport layer reliability and congestion mechanisms, up to Application layer services like DNS, HTTP, and FTP.
subjects.overviewHi: यह कोर्स कंप्यूटर नेटवर्किंग और डेटा संचार के मूलभूत और उन्नत सिद्धांतों को कवर करता है, जिसमें भौतिक ट्रांसमिशन मीडिया, डेटा लिंक लेयर फ्रेमिंग और एरर कंट्रोल, नेटवर्क लेयर आईपी रूटिंग और सबनेटिंग, ट्रांसपोर्ट लेयर रिलायबिलिटी और एप्लीकेशन लेयर प्रोटोकॉल (DNS, HTTP, FTP) शामिल हैं।
subjects.whyItMatters: Every connected device, web service, and distributed enterprise system relies upon deterministic data transmission protocols and scalable network topologies. Mastery of networking allows engineers to design, deploy, and troubleshoot modern internet-scale applications.

units.title: Data Communications and Transmission Media
units.overviewEn: Covers communication components, standard organizations, simplex/duplex transmission modes, digital/analog signal conversions, network classifications (LAN/WAN), network architectures, guided/unguided media, and multiplexing methods.
units.overviewHi: संचार घटक, मानक संगठन, सिम्प्लेक्स/डुप्लेक्स मोड, एनालॉग-डिजिटल रूपांतरण, लैन/वैन नेटवर्क वर्गीकरण, गाइडेड/अनगाइडेड मीडिया और मल्टीप्लेक्सिंग विधियों का परिचय।

topics.name: Data Communication Components & Communication Models
topics.explanationEn: Data communication is the exchange of data between two nodes via transmission media. Key components include Transmitter (source), Receiver (sink), Medium (path), Message (data/payload), and Protocol (governing rules). Transmission modes are Simplex (unidirectional, e.g., keyboard to monitor), Half-Duplex (bidirectional but sequential, e.g., walkie-talkie), and Full-Duplex (simultaneous bidirectional, e.g., telephone call).
topics.explanationHi: डेटा संचार दो नोड्स के बीच ट्रांसमिशन माध्यम से डेटा का आदान-प्रदान है। मुख्य घटकों में प्रेषक (Transmitter), रिसीवर (Receiver), माध्यम (Medium), संदेश (Message), और प्रोटोकॉल (Protocol) शामिल हैं। इसके मॉडल सिम्प्लेक्स, हाफ-डुप्लेक्स और फुल-डुप्लेक्स हैं।
topics.realWorldExample: Broadcasting over FM Radio is Simplex; using walkie-talkies where one speaks at a time is Half-Duplex; browsing a website with simultaneous uploads/downloads over broadband is Full-Duplex.

examQuestions.question: Differentiate between Simplex, Half-Duplex, and Full-Duplex communication with neat sketches and practical examples.
Define Baud Rate and Bit Rate. Calculate the bit rate if a signal carries 4 bits in each signal unit and 1000 signal units are sent per second.

topics.name: Transmission Media and Multiplexing
topics.explanationEn: Transmission media provide physical or atmospheric pathways for signal propagation. Guided media include Twisted Pair (UTP/STP for LAN), Coaxial cable (broadband/cable TV), and Optical Fiber (total internal reflection for ultra-high speeds). Unguided media utilize electromagnetic propagation via Radio waves, Microwaves, Infrared, and Satellite links. Multiplexing combines multiple analog or digital signals into a single shared medium using Frequency-Division Multiplexing (FDM) or Time-Division Multiplexing (TDM).
topics.explanationHi: गाइडेड ट्रांसमिशन मीडिया (ट्विस्टेड-पेयर, समाक्षीय केबल, ऑप्टिकल फाइबर) भौतिक तारों के माध्यम से सिग्नल भेजते हैं, जबकि अनगाइडेड मीडिया (रेडियो, माइक्रोवेव, इन्फ्रारेड, सैटेलाइट) हवा के माध्यम से सिग्नल प्रसारित करते हैं। मल्टीप्लेक्सिंग (FDM और TDM) एक चैनल पर कई सिग्नल ले जाने की तकनीक है।
topics.realWorldExample: Fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) broadband connections leverage optical fiber cables, while cellular phone networks share bandwidth using high-frequency radio waves multiplexed across user channels.

examQuestions.question: Compare Twisted Pair Cable, Coaxial Cable, and Fiber Optic Cable on the basis of bandwidth, attenuation, and noise immunity.
Explain Frequency-Division Multiplexing (FDM) and Time-Division Multiplexing (TDM) with operational diagrams.

units.title: Data Link Layer
units.overviewEn: Deals with node-to-node frame transmission, error detection and correction algorithms, sliding window protocols, medium access control (ALOHA, CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA), channelization schemes, and LAN switching architectures.
units.overviewHi: डेटा लिंक लेयर में नोड-टू-नोड डिलीवरी, एरर डिटेक्शन और करेक्शन (CRC, हैमिंग कोड), फ्लो और एरर कंट्रोल प्रोटोकॉल (Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat), CSMA/CD और स्विचिंग डिवाइसेज शामिल हैं।

topics.name: Error Detection and Correction (Hamming Code and CRC)
topics.explanationEn: Physical impairments induce bit corruptions. Redundancy bits are appended for detection and correction. Hamming distance measures the number of differing bits between codewords; minimum Hamming distance dictates detection/correction capacities. Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) utilizes polynomial division where the remainder serves as the frame check sequence. Checksum adds chunks of binary data using 1's complement arithmetic.
topics.explanationHi: डेटा ट्रांसमिशन में त्रुटियों की पहचान और सुधार के लिए रिडंडेंसी बिट्स जोड़ी जाती हैं। साइक्लिक रिडंडेंसी चेक (CRC) बहुपद विभाजन का उपयोग करता है और हैमिंग कोड न्यूनतम हैमिंग दूरी के सिद्धांत से एरर सुधारता है।
topics.realWorldExample: Ethernet frames append a 32-bit CRC (FCS) at the tail to instantly drop corrupted frames received by a network interface card without upper-layer CPU overhead.

examQuestions.question: Given data bit sequence 1101011011 and generator polynomial G(x) = x^4 + x + 1, compute the transmitted CRC codeword.
Distinguish between error detection and error correction. Explain how minimum Hamming distance determines both capabilities.

topics.name: Flow & Error Control Protocols and MAC Schemes
topics.explanationEn: Noiseless channels rely on Simplest and Stop-and-Wait mechanisms. Noisy channels introduce Automatic Repeat Request (ARQ) variants: Stop-and-Wait ARQ, Go-Back-N ARQ (sliding window where erroneous frame causes retransmission of all subsequent frames), and Selective Repeat ARQ (only flawed frames retransmitted). Random access MAC protocols resolve contention: Pure ALOHA, Slotted ALOHA, CSMA, CSMA/CD (used in half-duplex wired Ethernet), and CSMA/CA (used in 802.11 Wi-Fi).
topics.explanationHi: नोइजी चैनल प्रोटोकॉल में स्टॉप-एंड-वेट ARQ, गो-बैक-N ARQ और सेलेक्टिव रिपीट ARQ शामिल हैं। रैंडम एक्सेस मीडिया में CSMA/CD (वायर्ड ईथरनेट कोलिजन डिटेक्शन) और CSMA/CA (वाई-फाई कोलिजन अवॉइडेंस) प्रमुख हैं।
topics.realWorldExample: Wi-Fi routers utilize CSMA/CA with RTS/CTS exchange to avoid radio signal collisions when multiple laptops attempt to transmit across the airwaves simultaneously.

examQuestions.question: Explain the working of Go-Back-N ARQ protocol and contrast it with Selective Repeat ARQ in terms of window size and buffer utilization.
Describe the operational steps of Carrier Sense Multiple Access with Collision Detection (CSMA/CD).

units.title: Network Layer
units.overviewEn: Covers end-to-end packet delivery, IPv4 addressing schemes, classful vs classless (CIDR) addressing, subnetting and supernetting mathematics, NAT, packet fragmentation, IPv6 basics, ARP/RARP, and IP routing algorithms.
units.overviewHi: नेटवर्क लेयर एंड-टू-एंड पैकेट डिलीवरी, IPv4 एड्रेसिंग, सबनेटिंग और सुपरनेटिंग, NAT, पैकेट विखंडन (Fragmentation), IPv6, ARP/RARP और रूटिंग एल्गोरिदम को कवर करता है।

topics.name: IPv4 Addressing, Subnetting, and NAT
topics.explanationEn: An IPv4 address is a 32-bit identifier divided into network and host segments. Classful addressing defines Classes A, B, C, D, and E. Subnetting subdivides large networks into smaller subnets using custom subnet masks, mitigating broadcast overhead and conserving addresses. Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) uses variable-length subnet masks (VLSM). Network Address Translation (NAT) maps multiple private IP addresses to a single public IP, conserving IPv4 space.
topics.explanationHi: IPv4 एक 32-बिट एड्रेस है जिसे क्लास A, B, C, D, E में बांटा गया था। सबनेटिंग बड़े नेटवर्क को छोटे सबनेट्स में विभाजित करती है। NAT निजी (Private) आईपी को सार्वजनिक (Public) आईपी में बदलता है।
topics.realWorldExample: A college campus assigns private IPs (192.168.1.0/24) to 200 lab computers; when students browse the internet, the border router uses NAT to translate requests under one public ISP-assigned IP.

examQuestions.question: An organization is granted the block 200.16.0.0/24. The administrator needs to create 4 subnets. Find the subnet mask, network address, and usable IP range for each subnet.
What is Network Address Translation (NAT)? Explain its advantages and operating mechanisms.

topics.name: IP Header, Fragmentation, ARP/RARP, and IPv6
topics.explanationEn: The IPv4 datagram includes flags and offset fields to handle fragmentation when packet sizes exceed Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU). Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) translates logical IP addresses into physical MAC addresses via broadcast requests and unicast replies. RARP performs the inverse. IPv6 introduces 128-bit addresses, simplifies the header, removes checksums to accelerate forwarding, and supports dual-stack/tunneling for backward compatibility.
topics.explanationHi: IPv4 हैडर में MTU से बड़े पैकेट्स को तोड़ने के लिए फ्रैग्मेंटेशन फ़ील्ड्स होते हैं। ARP आईपी एड्रेस को भौतिक MAC एड्रेस में बदलता है। IPv6 128-बिट एड्रेस स्पेस प्रदान करता है।
topics.realWorldExample: When a computer connects to a new Ethernet switch, it emits an ARP broadcast: 'Who has IP 192.168.1.1? Tell 192.168.1.100' to discover the router's physical MAC address.

examQuestions.question: Explain the step-by-step working of Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) with a scenario diagram.
Compare IPv4 and IPv6 headers. Why was IPv6 introduced?

units.title: Transport Layer
units.overviewEn: Examines process-to-process delivery, port numbering, connectionless UDP architecture vs connection-oriented TCP reliable streaming, TCP flow control, 3-way handshaking, and congestion mitigation schemes.
units.overviewHi: प्रोसेस-टू-प्रोसेस डिलीवरी, पोर्ट नंबर्स, कनेक्शनलेस UDP बनाम कनेक्शन-ओरिएंटेड TCP, 3-वे हैंडशेक, फ्लो कंट्रोल (स्लाइडिंग विंडो), और कंजेशन कंट्रोल का विस्तृत अध्ययन।

topics.name: TCP vs UDP Protocols and Connection Management
topics.explanationEn: The Transport layer achieves process-to-process communication using 16-bit port numbers. User Datagram Protocol (UDP) is connectionless, unreliable, lightweight, and lacks flow control—ideal for real-time traffic. Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) is connection-oriented, full-duplex, and reliable. TCP establishes sessions via a 3-Way Handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) and terminates sessions via FIN-ACK handshakes, utilizing sequence and acknowledgment numbers for continuous byte-stream tracking.
topics.explanationHi: ट्रांसपोर्ट लेयर पोर्ट नंबर के माध्यम से प्रोसेस-टू-प्रोसेस डिलीवरी करती है। UDP तेज लेकिन अविश्वसनीय (Unreliable) है, जबकि TCP कनेक्शन-ओरिएंटेड है और 3-वे हैंडशेक के माध्यम से विश्वसनीय संचार सुनिश्चित करता है।
topics.realWorldExample: Video voice streaming over Discord or online multiplayer gaming uses UDP for low latency, whereas banking transactions and file downloads rely on TCP to prevent byte drops.

examQuestions.question: Differentiate between TCP and UDP based on connection orientation, header overhead, reliability, and typical application protocols.
Illustrate the TCP Three-Way Handshake process during connection establishment.

topics.name: Flow Control and Congestion Control in TCP
topics.explanationEn: Flow control prevents a fast sender from overwhelming a slow receiver using TCP's Sliding Window and receiver advertised window (rwnd). Congestion control prevents network pipeline collapse caused by packet queuing delays and drops across intermediate routers. Approaches include Open-Loop (prevention: retransmission policy, discarding) and Closed-Loop (reactive: Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance, Fast Retransmit, and Fast Recovery using cwnd thresholds).
topics.explanationHi: फ्लो कंट्रोल रिसीवर बफर को भरने से रोकता है (rwnd द्वारा)। कंजेशन कंट्रोल नेटवर्क में ट्रैफिक जाम से बचाता है। इसमें स्लो स्टार्ट, कंजेशन अवॉइडेंस और फास्ट रीट्रांसमिट जैसी तकनीकें शामिल हैं।
topics.realWorldExample: When a network suddenly drops packets due to peak congestion, TCP shrinks its congestion window (cwnd) exponentially to decrease the packet injection rate and preserve network integrity.

examQuestions.question: Explain TCP Slow Start and Congestion Avoidance algorithms with a graph illustrating cwnd progression over transmission rounds.
Distinguish between Open-Loop and Closed-Loop congestion control mechanisms.

units.title: Application Layer
units.overviewEn: Introduces high-level network services including Domain Name System (DNS) architecture and resolution, Web protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, persistent vs non-persistent connections, cookies, proxies), dynamic addressing via DHCP, Telnet, electronic mail pipelines (SMTP, POP3, IMAP), and FTP file transfers.
units.overviewHi: DNS आर्किटेक्चर, वेब प्रोटोकॉल (HTTP/HTTPS, कुकीज, प्रॉक्सी सर्वर), DHCP, रिमोट लॉगिंग (Telnet), ईमेल आर्किटेक्चर (SMTP, POP3, IMAP) और FTP फाइल ट्रांसफर।

topics.name: DNS and Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP)
topics.explanationEn: DNS is a distributed hierarchical database mapping human-readable domain names to numerical IP addresses across Root, TLD, and Authoritative servers via Recursive or Iterative resolution. DHCP automates host network configuration dynamically by executing the DORA process: Discover (broadcast), Offer (unicast/broadcast from server), Request (client selection), and Acknowledgment (lease finalization with IP, gateway, DNS).
topics.explanationHi: DNS एक पदानुक्रमित डेटाबेस है जो डोमेन नामों को आईपी में बदलता है। DHCP DORA प्रक्रिया (Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge) द्वारा कंप्यूटर को स्वचालित रूप से आईपी एड्रेस आवंटित करता है।
topics.realWorldExample: When you type 'google.com', your browser resolver contacts a recursive DNS server to find 142.250.190.46; when your smartphone joins a cafe Wi-Fi, DHCP instantly assigns it a local IP.

examQuestions.question: Explain Recursive and Iterative DNS resolution processes with diagrams.
Describe the 4-step DHCP DORA mechanism for dynamic host configuration.

topics.name: HTTP, Electronic Mail (SMTP/POP3/IMAP), and FTP
topics.explanationEn: HTTP operates on client-server request-response architecture. Non-persistent HTTP closes the TCP connection after every object; persistent HTTP keeps connections open for multiple pipelined transfers. Cookies maintain stateful sessions. E-mail architecture splits tasks into Mail User Agent (MUA), Mail Transfer Agent (MTA) running SMTP to push emails between servers, and Mail Access Agents (POP3 downloads and removes; IMAP synchronizes remotely across multiple devices). FTP utilizes separate Control (Port 21) and Data (Port 20) channels.
topics.explanationHi: HTTP वेब ब्राउज़िंग के लिए उपयोग होता है। ईमेल में SMTP सर्वर-टू-सर्वर मेल भेजने (Push) के लिए और POP3/IMAP मेल रिसीव (Pull) करने के लिए प्रयुक्त होते हैं। FTP पोर्ट 21 (कंट्रोल) और पोर्ट 20 (डेटा) का उपयोग करता है।
topics.realWorldExample: Gmail uses SMTP to transmit your sent email to Outlook's server; your smartphone mail app uses IMAP so that read emails stay synchronized across your phone and laptop.

examQuestions.question: Compare POP3 and IMAP mail access protocols in terms of synchronization and offline accessibility.
Why does FTP require two separate connections (Control and Data)? Explain its working architecture.

subjects.name: Software Engineering
subjects.overviewEn: Systematic engineering discipline emphasizing rigorous software lifecycle processes, requirement engineering (SRS), structural and behavioral design modeling, project metrics estimation (COCOMO, FP, LoC), risk management, testing methodologies, and project scheduling via CPM/PERT.
subjects.overviewHi: सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियरिंग सॉफ्टवेयर विकास के सिद्धांतों, आवश्यकताओं के विश्लेषण (SRS), डिजाइन मॉडलिंग (DFD, UML), लागत और आकार अनुमान (COCOMO, फंक्शन पॉइंट्स), सॉफ्टवेयर टेस्टिंग और CPM/PERT प्रोजेक्ट शेड्यूलिंग को कवर करता है।
subjects.whyItMatters: Writing ad-hoc code leads to project failure, budget overruns, and unmaintainable architectures. Software engineering ensures scalable, robust, and verifiable software built within strict schedules and resource budgets.

units.title: Software Development Process
units.overviewEn: Explores types of software, software engineering layered approach, prescriptive process models (Waterfall, Incremental, RAD, Spiral), and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Extreme Programming, Crystal).
units.overviewHi: सॉफ्टवेयर के प्रकार, लेयर्ड एप्रोच, क्लासिकल प्रोसेस मॉडल (Waterfall, Spiral) और एजाइल फ्रेमवर्क (Scrum, XP) का अध्ययन।

topics.name: Software Process Framework & Prescriptive Models
topics.explanationEn: Software engineering is a layered technology consisting of Quality focus, Process, Methods, and Tools. Prescriptive process models enforce structured engineering phases. Waterfall is sequential, suitable when requirements are fixed and well-understood. The Spiral model integrates explicit risk assessment loops in each phase. Incremental models deliver functional releases sequentially.
topics.explanationHi: सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियरिंग क्वालिटी, प्रोसेस, मेथड्स और टूल्स पर आधारित लेयर्ड तकनीक है। वॉटरफॉल मॉडल निश्चित आवश्यकताओं के लिए उपयुक्त है, जबकि स्पाइरल मॉडल रिस्क एनालिसिस पर आधारित है।
topics.realWorldExample: Developing flight control software for avionics mandates a rigorous Waterfall or V-Model, where specifications are non-negotiable and safety verifications must be documented at each gate.

examQuestions.question: Explain the Spiral Model with a quadrant diagram and explain why it is recognized as a risk-driven model.
Under what software development scenarios is the classical Waterfall model preferred?

topics.name: Agile Software Development and Scrum
topics.explanationEn: Agile methodologies value individuals and interactions, working software, customer collaboration, and responding to change over rigid documentation. Scrum utilizes short 2-4 week Sprints, daily standups, Sprint Planning, Product Backlogs, and Retrospectives led by a Scrum Master. Extreme Programming (XP) promotes pair programming, test-driven development (TDD), and continuous refactoring.
topics.explanationHi: एजाइल मॉडल त्वरित बदलाव और ग्राहक सहयोग को प्राथमिकता देता है। स्क्रम में 2-4 सप्ताह के स्प्रिंट, प्रोडक्ट बैकलॉग और डेली स्टैंडअप मीटिंग्स के माध्यम से काम किया जाता है।
topics.realWorldExample: A modern fintech startup releasing weekly mobile app updates operates in 2-week Scrum sprints to incorporate customer feedback quickly.

examQuestions.question: Explain the core ceremonies and roles in a Scrum framework (Product Owner, Scrum Master, Sprint Planning, Retrospective).

units.title: Software Requirement Engineering
units.overviewEn: Focuses on requirement elicitation, functional and non-functional requirements, use-case modeling, requirement negotiation, validation, and drafting structured Software Requirements Specifications (SRS) conforming to IEEE standards.
units.overviewHi: आवश्यकता एकत्रण (Elicitation), फंक्शनल और नॉन-फंक्शनल आवश्यकताएं, यूज-केस मॉडलिंग और सॉफ्टवेयर रिक्वायरमेंट्स स्पेसिफिकेशन (SRS) का प्रारूप।

topics.name: Requirement Elicitation, Modeling, and SRS
topics.explanationEn: Requirement Engineering comprises Inception, Elicitation (interviews, surveys, JAD), Elaboration, Negotiation, Specification, and Validation. Requirements are classified into Functional (system actions) and Non-Functional (performance, security, usability). The Software Requirements Specification (SRS) is a formal contract outlining complete system behavior, characterized by correctness, unambiguousness, completeness, consistency, and verifiability.
topics.explanationHi: रिक्वायरमेंट इंजीनियरिंग में आवश्यकता जुटाना, विश्लेषण और सत्यापन शामिल है। SRS एक औपचारिक दस्तावेज है जो सिस्टम की कार्यात्मक और गैर-कार्यात्मक आवश्यकताओं को परिभाषित करता है।
topics.realWorldExample: In an ATM system, 'Debit account balance on cash dispense' is a functional requirement, whereas 'Process transaction within 2 seconds with 256-bit encryption' is a non-functional requirement.

examQuestions.question: What is an SRS? Explain any five desirable characteristics of a good Software Requirements Specification document.
Differentiate between Functional and Non-Functional requirements with two examples of each.

units.title: Software Modeling and Design
units.overviewEn: Examines translation of requirements into architectural and data designs, core principles (abstraction, modularity, information hiding), Data Flow Diagrams (DFDs), structure flowcharts, and decision tables.
units.overviewHi: सिस्टम डिजाइन सिद्धांत (एब्स्ट्रैक्शन, मॉड्यूलरिटी, इंफॉर्मेशन हाइडिंग), डेटा फ्लो डायग्राम (DFD) और डिसीजन टेबल्स।

topics.name: Design Concepts and Data Flow Diagrams (DFD)
topics.explanationEn: Fundamental design concepts include Abstraction, Modularity (high cohesion, low coupling), Information Hiding, and Software Architecture. A Data Flow Diagram (DFD) models the graphical flow of data through an information system. DFD components include External Entities (squares), Processes (circles/rounded rectangles), Data Stores (open rectangles), and Data Flows (directed arrows). Systems are refined hierarchically from Context Level (Level 0) down to Levels 1 and 2.
topics.explanationHi: सॉफ्टवेयर डिजाइन में मॉड्यूलरिटी (हाई कोहेसन और लो कपलिंग) जरूरी है। डेटा फ्लो डायग्राम (DFD) सिस्टम के भीतर डेटा के प्रवाह और प्रोसेसिंग को चित्रों के माध्यम से दर्शाता है।
topics.realWorldExample: Designing an Online Bookstore involves a Level-0 Context DFD showing Customer and Payment Gateway entities exchanging order data with the main E-Commerce Engine.

examQuestions.question: Explain Cohesion and Coupling. Why is high cohesion and low coupling desired in software design?
Draw Level-0 and Level-1 Data Flow Diagrams (DFD) for a Library Management System.

units.title: Software Project Estimation
units.overviewEn: Covers management 4P spectrum (People, Product, Process, Project), size estimation (LoC and Function Points), empirical estimation using COCOMO I & II, and Risk Management strategies (RMMM).
units.overviewHi: सॉफ्टवेयर प्रोजेक्ट एस्टीमेशन, LoC, फंक्शन पॉइंट्स (FP), COCOMO मॉडल, और रिस्क मैनेजमेंट (RMMM रणनीति)।

topics.name: Metrics, COCOMO Model, and RMMM Strategy
topics.explanationEn: Software metrics quantify attributes: Lines of Code (LoC) measures volume, while Function Points (FP) measures functionality delivered based on inputs, outputs, inquiries, internal files, and external interfaces. The Constructive Cost Model (COCOMO) estimates effort (Person-Months) and development time across Organic, Semidetached, and Embedded modes: Effort = a*(KLoC)^b. Risk Mitigation, Monitoring, and Management (RMMM) details steps to avert, track, and handle software contingencies.
topics.explanationHi: सॉफ्टवेयर साइज मापने के लिए LoC और FP का उपयोग होता है। COCOMO मॉडल प्रोजेक्ट में लगने वाले समय और लागत का अनुमान लगाता है। RMMM रिस्क से निपटने की रणनीति है।
topics.realWorldExample: Before developing an enterprise banking portal of 50 KLoC, managers use COCOMO equations to determine that the project needs 14 software engineers for 9 months.

examQuestions.question: Explain Basic COCOMO model. Differentiate between Organic, Semidetached, and Embedded software projects.
What is the RMMM Plan? Explain Risk Mitigation, Monitoring, and Management with an industry example.

units.title: Software Testing and Quality Assurance
units.overviewEn: Details software verification and validation, Black-box and White-box testing, unit/integration/system testing, test case documentation, defect reporting, SQA activities, and quality standards (CMMI, ISO, Six Sigma).
units.overviewHi: सॉफ्टवेयर टेस्टिंग (ब्लैक-बॉक्स, व्हाइट-बॉक्स), टेस्ट केस डिजाइन, डिफेक्ट रिपोर्टिंग, सॉफ्टवेयर क्वालिटी एश्योरेंस (SQA), और CMMI / ISO मानक।

topics.name: Testing Techniques, Test Documentation, and SQA
topics.explanationEn: Testing executes software to reveal defects. Black-Box Testing examines external functionality without internal code knowledge (Equivalence Partitioning, Boundary Value Analysis). White-Box Testing evaluates internal logic paths (Basis Path Testing, Cyclomatic Complexity). Levels include Unit, Integration, System, and Acceptance Testing. Software Quality Assurance (SQA) enforces organizational audits, defect tracking, and process adherence (CMMI Levels 1 to 5).
topics.explanationHi: ब्लैक-बॉक्स टेस्टिंग में कोड देखे बिना इनपुट-आउटपुट जांचा जाता है, जबकि व्हाइट-बॉक्स में आंतरिक कोड लॉजिक टेस्ट होता है। CMMI और ISO सॉफ्टवेयर की गुणवत्ता सुनिश्चित करते हैं।
topics.realWorldExample: Testing a login password field that requires 8-16 characters by submitting 7, 8, 16, and 17 characters is an application of Boundary Value Analysis.

examQuestions.question: Differentiate between Black-Box and White-Box testing. Explain Boundary Value Analysis with an example.
Explain the five maturity levels of Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI).

units.title: Software Project Management
units.overviewEn: Addresses project scheduling principles, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Activity Networks, Critical Path Method (CPM), PERT techniques, timeline charts (Gantt charts), and Earned Value Analysis for progress tracking.
units.overviewHi: प्रोजेक्ट शेड्यूलिंग, वर्क ब्रेकडाउन स्ट्रक्चर (WBS), क्रिटिकल पाथ मेथड (CPM), PERT चार्ट, गैंट चार्ट (Gantt Charts) और प्रोजेक्ट ट्रैकिंग तकनीकें।

topics.name: Project Scheduling, CPM/PERT, and Gantt Charts
topics.explanationEn: Project management deconstructs software initiatives into hierarchical tasks using Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). The Critical Path Method (CPM) finds the longest sequence of dependent activities having zero slack/float, establishing the absolute minimum project completion time. PERT incorporates probabilistic three-point duration estimates. Gantt charts visually map milestone timelines, resource allocations, and real-time execution progress.
topics.explanationHi: WBS प्रोजेक्ट को छोटे कार्यों में विभाजित करता है। क्रिटिकल पाथ मेथड (CPM) प्रोजेक्ट पूरा करने के सबसे लंबे रास्ते और न्यूनतम आवश्यक समय को निर्धारित करता है। गैंट चार्ट समय सारिणी को ट्रैक करता है।
topics.realWorldExample: A project manager uses a Gantt Chart in Jira to confirm that the database migration task is on the critical path; any 2-day delay on that task directly postpones the app launch date.

examQuestions.question: Given an activity network with task dependencies and durations, determine the Critical Path and total project completion time.
Explain the significance of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and Gantt Charts in tracking software progress.

subjects.name: Data Science: Data Warehousing and Data Mining
subjects.overviewEn: A program elective establishing competencies in analytical databases and knowledge discovery. Covers data warehouse architectures (Star/Snowflake schema, OLAP cubes), data preprocessing (cleaning, transformation, reduction), classification algorithms (Decision Trees, Naive Bayes), and clustering algorithms (K-Means, Hierarchical).
subjects.overviewHi: डेटा वेयरहाउसिंग और डेटा माइनिंग का यह कोर्स एनालिटिकल डेटाबेस, OLAP क्यूब्स, डेटा प्री-प्रोसेसिंग (क्लीनिंग, ट्रांसफॉर्मेशन), क्लासिफिकेशन (डिसीजन ट्री, नेव बेयस) और क्लस्टरिंग (K-मीन्स) तकनीकों को सिखाता है।
subjects.whyItMatters: Enterprises generate petabytes of transactional records. Data warehousing organizes historical information for reporting, while data mining extracts predictive patterns and strategic business intelligence.

units.title: Data Warehousing and OLAP Technology
units.overviewEn: Differentiates OLTP and OLAP systems, explores operational data store (ODS) and multi-tiered data warehouse architectures, multidimensional data models (Star, Snowflake, Fact Constellation schemas), and OLAP operations (Roll-up, Drill-down, Slice, Dice, Pivot).
units.overviewHi: OLTP और OLAP में अंतर, डेटा वेयरहाउस आर्किटेक्चर, स्टार और स्नोफ्लेक स्कीमा, और OLAP ऑपरेशंस (Roll-up, Drill-down, Slice, Dice)।

topics.name: Data Warehouse Architecture and Multidimensional Data Models
topics.explanationEn: A Data Warehouse is a subject-oriented, integrated, time-variant, and non-volatile collection of data used for managerial decisions. It differs from OLTP (transaction-focused, normalized) by being OLAP-focused (query/analysis-focused, denormalized). Multidimensional modeling relies on fact tables (containing numerical metrics) surrounded by dimension tables (descriptive attributes). Schemas include Star Schema (single centralized fact with denormalized dimensions), Snowflake Schema (dimensions normalized into sub-tables), and Fact Constellation.
topics.explanationHi: डेटा वेयरहाउस एक सब्जेक्ट-ओरिएंटेड, इंटीग्रेटेड और नॉन-वोलेटाइल डेटा रिपॉजिटरी है। स्टार स्कीमा में केंद्रीय फैक्ट टेबल होती है जिसके चारों ओर डायमेंशन टेबल जुड़ी होती हैं।
topics.realWorldExample: Walmart aggregates point-of-sale receipt facts with Product, Store Location, and Date dimensions to analyze annual festive sales patterns.

examQuestions.question: Differentiate between Operational Database Systems (OLTP) and Data Warehouses (OLAP) across at least 5 parameters.
Explain Star Schema and Snowflake Schema with neat illustrative database schema diagrams.

units.title: Data Preprocessing Techniques
units.overviewEn: Emphasizes the necessity of clean data in KDD, detailing Data Cleaning (handling missing values and noisy data), Data Integration, Data Transformation (normalization, aggregation), and Data Reduction (dimensionality and numerosity reduction).
units.overviewHi: नॉलेज डिस्कवरी के लिए डेटा प्री-प्रोसेसिंग: डेटा क्लीनिंग (मिसिंग वैल्यूज, नॉइज़ हटाना), डेटा ट्रांसफॉर्मेशन (नॉर्मलाइजेशन), और डेटा रिडक्शन (PCA, बिनिंग)।

topics.name: Data Cleaning, Transformation, and Reduction
topics.explanationEn: Raw real-world data is dirty: incomplete, noisy, and inconsistent. Preprocessing prepares data for machine learning. Data Cleaning handles missing values (imputation via mean/mode/regression) and smooths noisy data via binning, clustering, or regression. Data Transformation normalizes scales using Min-Max Normalization ((v - min)/(max - min)) or Z-score normalization. Data Reduction reduces representation volume via Principal Component Analysis (PCA), feature selection, and sampling.
topics.explanationHi: डेटा क्लीनिंग में छूटे हुए मान भरना और नॉइज़ दूर करना शामिल है। डेटा ट्रांसफॉर्मेशन में मिन-मैक्स नॉर्मलाइजेशन द्वारा डेटा को एक समान स्केल (0 से 1) पर लाया जाता है।
topics.realWorldExample: Scaling income (range 10,000 to 1,000,000) and age (range 18 to 80) to between [0, 1] so that large income values do not disproportionately distort machine learning distance calculations.

examQuestions.question: Given raw dataset values [13, 15, 16, 16, 19, 20, 20, 21, 22, 22, 25, 30], demonstrate smoothing by bin means using bin depth 3.
Explain Min-Max Normalization and Z-Score Normalization with mathematical formulas.

units.title: Data Mining: Classification and Clustering
units.overviewEn: Explores supervised predictive classification models including Decision Tree Induction (Information Gain, Gini Index) and Naive Bayes, alongside unsupervised clustering techniques like K-Means and agglomerative hierarchical clustering.
units.overviewHi: सुपरवाइज्ड क्लासिफिकेशन (डिसीजन ट्री, इन्फॉर्मेशन गेन, नेव बेयस क्लासिफायर) और अनसुपरवाइज्ड क्लस्टरिंग (K-मीन्स एल्गोरिदम)।

topics.name: Classification (Decision Trees & Naive Bayes) and K-Means Clustering
topics.explanationEn: Classification predicts discrete class labels for unseen instances. Decision Tree algorithms (ID3/C4.5) use Information Gain based on Entropy to select split attributes. Naive Bayes classification computes posterior probabilities using Bayes' Theorem under conditional independence assumptions. Clustering groups unlabeled data points so that intra-cluster similarity is maximized and inter-cluster similarity is minimized. K-Means partitions data into k clusters iteratively by recomputing centroid means until convergence.
topics.explanationHi: क्लासिफिकेशन (डिसीजन ट्री और नेव बेयस) डेटा के क्लास लेबल की भविष्यवाणी करता है। K-मीन्स क्लस्टरिंग बिना लेबल वाले डेटा को सेंट्रोइड दूरी के आधार पर k समूहों में बांटता है।
topics.realWorldExample: Banks run Naive Bayes classifiers to evaluate whether loan applicants are 'High Risk' or 'Low Risk', and run K-Means to discover distinct customer spending archetypes for targeted credit card marketing.

examQuestions.question: Explain the step-by-step algorithm of K-Means clustering. What are its limitations regarding outlier sensitivity?
Define Entropy and Information Gain in the context of Decision Tree Induction.

practicals.title: Identification of Network Devices and Preparation of UTP Cables
practicals.objective: Identify networking hardware (NIC, Hub, Switch, Router) and crimp straight-through and crossover UTP cables according to EIA/TIA 568A and 568B standards.
practicals.preLabConcepts: Pinout diagrams of T568A and T568B, color coding of 8-wire twisted pairs, RJ-45 jacks, difference between crossover and straight cables.
practicals.requiredTools: Cat-5e/Cat-6 UTP cable, RJ-45 connectors, Crimping Tool, Wire stripper, Network Cable Tester.
prepChecklist: Ensure network cable tester battery is charged

practicals.title: Creation of Star Topology and Wireless NIC File Transfer
practicals.objective: Build a wired Local Area Network using Star topology connected through a central Switch, and configure an Ad-hoc/Infrastructure Wi-Fi connection to transmit files.
practicals.preLabConcepts: Star topology hub-and-spoke advantages, collision domains, SSID, WPA2 pre-shared keys, file sharing permissions.
practicals.requiredTools: Desktop PCs / Laptops, Ethernet Switch (8/16 port), UTP Straight cables, Wireless NIC cards.
prepChecklist: Verify link status LEDs upon cable insertion
Enable network file discovery in operating system

practicals.title: Host IP Configuration and Peer-to-Peer Connection Setup
practicals.objective: Configure static IPv4 addresses, subnet masks, and default gateways in Windows/Linux, and link two computers back-to-back using a crossover cable.
practicals.preLabConcepts: IPv4 addressing, Default Subnet Masks (Class C: 255.255.255.0), ICMP Ping utility, ARP resolution.
practicals.requiredTools: Two desktop/laptop workstations, Crossover UTP cable, Command Prompt / Terminal.
prepChecklist: Ensure both workstations share the identical subnet ID
Temporarily allow ICMP Echo Request in the firewall
Run 'ping' to confirm end-to-end packet exchange

practicals.title: Packet Capture & Protocol Header Analysis and Telnet Configuration
practicals.objective: Capture live network packets using Wireshark / Cisco Packet Tracer, dissect TCP/IP protocol headers, and establish a remote terminal connection using Telnet.
practicals.preLabConcepts: Packet sniffing, promiscuous mode, Ethernet frame header, IPv4 header flags, TCP header sequence flags, Port 23 operation.
practicals.requiredTools: Workstation with Wireshark installed, Cisco Packet Tracer, Telnet client/daemon.
prepChecklist: Enable Telnet Client feature in Windows optional features
Apply Wireshark display filters such as 'ip.addr == target'

practicals.title: Creation and Configuration of HTTP and FTP Servers
practicals.objective: Set up a local HTTP web server and an FTP server to host web pages and manage remote file upload and download directories.
practicals.preLabConcepts: Client-server architecture, HTTP port 80/8080, FTP control port 21 & data port 20, IIS / Apache / FileZilla configuration.
practicals.requiredTools: Server software (Apache/IIS/XAMPP, FileZilla Server), Client web browser, FTP Client (FileZilla Client/WinSCP).
prepChecklist: Ensure port 80 and port 21 are open in local firewall
Create sample index.html page in root directory
Configure read/write credentials for FTP test user

termWork.title: Term Work & Continuous Assessment for DCCN (S2418501)
termWork.componentType: Lab Records, Micro-Project, and Technical Assignments
termWork.guidelines: Students must maintain a neat laboratory practical record, complete analytical assignments on subnetting and error control calculations, complete a networking micro-project, and present a technical seminar. Assessment is structured as 40% internal continuous evaluation and 60% external evaluation.

termWork.title: Term Work & Technical Portfolio for Software Engineering (S2418502)
termWork.componentType: Case Study SRS, UML Models, Testing Reports, and Micro-Project
termWork.guidelines: Students must formulate a full IEEE 830 compliant SRS document for an allotted domain, build DFD and UML diagrams using CASE tools, devise test plans with test case matrices, construct Gantt charts using project management software, and present seminar topics. Evaluated 40% internally and 60% externally.

termWork.title: Summer Internship-II / Industrial Training Portfolio (2418506)
termWork.componentType: Industrial Training Diary & Technical Project Report
termWork.guidelines: Documentation of industrial training carried out after the 4th semester. Must include company profile, technology stack studied, real-world development tasks completed, certificate of completion, and formal viva defense.

termWork.title: Minor Project Phase Documentation (2418507)
termWork.componentType: Problem Definition, System Design, Prototype Demonstration
termWork.guidelines: Team-based execution of a preliminary computer engineering software/hardware project. Requires literature survey, synopsis submission, architectural modeling, baseline prototype code, and final project demonstration.

microProjects.title: Local Subnet Socket-Based Multi-Client Chat Application
microProjects.description: Design and build a client-server chat program running over TCP/IP sockets allowing multiple peer workstations within the computer lab to exchange encrypted text broadcasts and unicast direct messages.
microProjects.officialRequirements: Implement process-to-process communication using socket programming, bind host IP and port numbers, manage multi-threaded client connections, and handle clean socket closures.
stages: Requirements definition and protocol packet structure design
Implementation of multi-threaded TCP server socket in Python/Java
Client UI creation and LAN connectivity testing
Traffic validation using Wireshark packet capture analysis
suggestedAiProjects: AI-assisted LAN anomaly traffic detector using Python scapy and Random Forest
Automated subnet calculator bot using large language model prompts

microProjects.title: Real-Time Network Bandwidth & Latency Monitor Tool
microProjects.description: Develop a lightweight network utility that captures real-time throughput (bytes sent/received), packet loss, and round-trip ping latency across a local network adapter, rendering real-time graphs.
microProjects.officialRequirements: Use networking APIs or command interfaces to poll adapter metrics, log historical usage, and display bandwidth utilization metrics.
stages: Select programming framework (e.g., Python psutil, scapy)
Build background metric sampler measuring transmit/receive rates
Integrate graphical desktop or web visualization dashboard
Stress test with high-traffic downloads to confirm accuracy
suggestedAiProjects: Predictive bandwidth saturation forecaster using LSTM time-series models
Smart QoS optimizer prioritizing packets using heuristic learning

microProjects.title: Comprehensive SRS, UML Modeling & Automated Testing for Health Clinic System
microProjects.description: Formulate a complete IEEE-standard Software Requirement Specification (SRS) for a Patient Appointment and Health Records system, build complete DFDs/UML diagrams, and run automated Selenium test scripts.
microProjects.officialRequirements: Complete requirement elicitation, produce SRS document, build Level 0/1 DFDs, design test case suite with boundary value analysis, execute automated tests using Selenium/JUnit, and build CPM/Gantt timeline.
stages: Problem analysis and elicitation of functional/non-functional requirements
Drafting SRS document adhering to IEEE 830 format
Modeling system flows via DFDs and UML structural diagrams
Drafting test plan and executing automated test scripts
Project scheduling using Gantt charts in Jira/MS Project and final submission

assessment.examPattern: For theory courses with 70 End Theory marks (ETA): 3 hours written examination consisting of objective/multiple-choice questions, short-answer questions (4-6 marks), and detailed analytical/numerical long-answer questions (6-8 marks) covering all 5-6 units. Progressive Theory Assessment (PTA) consists of 30 marks calculated via mid-term tests, class quizzes, and continuous evaluation.
assessment.evaluationCriteria: Theory courses (e.g., DCCN: 200 marks total) break down into: PTA = 30 marks, ETA = 70 marks, Term Work = 50 marks (20 internal + 30 external), Lab Assessment = 50 marks (20 PLA + 30 ELA). Term work is split strictly into 40% internal guide assessment and 60% external examiner assessment based on rubrics (Process 40%, Product 50%, Viva-voce 10%).
assessment.studyStrategyAdvice: Focus heavily on numerical problems and step-by-step algorithms: in DCCN, master Subnetting math (CIDR/VLSM), CRC polynomial divisions, and the TCP 3-Way Handshake flow. In Software Engineering, master drawing clear DFD Level 0/1 diagrams, calculating COCOMO effort equations, and solving Critical Path Method (CPM) networks. Maintain clean lab records and prepare for practical viva by memorizing port numbers, cable color codes, and Wireshark capture filters.
